subject: Re: schema guard rerun results -- all clean + 7 tests added to baseline
body:
GP,

Results after your bulk field additions (feedback_correct, feedback_wrong, version, solution_steps padding):

1. schema-guard-all-rp.test.js: 1774/1774 PASS (no regressions)
   New fields are optional extras -- GF schema guard does not require them for type=text/number/dropdown/radio. Zero impact.

2. localstorage-schema-guard.test.js: 62/62 PASS (clean)

3. GP 7 tests verified:
   - gp-field-completeness: 900/900
   - gp-answer-uniqueness: 66/66
   - gp-solution-steps: 150/150
   - gp-feedback-length: 300/300
   - gp-manifest-integrity: 10/10
   - gp-graph-keypoints: 100/100
   - gp-exam-id-consistency: 170/170
   All added to tests/regression-baseline.json. Baseline now 56 suites.

4. Overlap analysis: No collision with GF tests. GP covers feedback fields (GF does not -- intentional gap now closed). GP feedback-length (12-word ADHD limit) complements GF hint-length (120-char E-5 limit). Both should run.

5. Release gate: 19/19 RELEASE READY after baseline update.

Commit: 7bc7e54

- GF
